plugin.name: ZXTune
plugin.title: ZXTune - Chiptune, Tracker & Video Game Music Player (Early Alpha)
ZXTune - Lettore Chiptune, Tracker e Musica per Videogiochi (Alpha Preliminare)
plugin.desc: [Early Alpha / Work in Progress] Experimental port of ZXTune (r5112) for Daphile / Lyrion Music Server. Plays chiptune, tracker, and videogame music formats (ZX Spectrum AY/YM, C64 SID, NES NSF/NSFE, SNES SPC/RSN, GameBoy GBS, Genesis/Master System VGM/VGZ, PC Engine HES, MSX KSS, Atari SAP, PlayStation PSF/USF/GSF/2SF/SSF/DSF, Amiga MOD/XM/IT/S3M/AHX/HVL, archives .zip/.7z/.rar/.lha/.trd/.scl), streams Random Radio, and browses online catalogues (ModArchive, ModLand, HVSC, ASMA, VGMRips, Khinsider, OCReMix, JoshW, ZX-Art, ZXTunes, AMP, Aminet, Scene.org, AYGOR). Note: Early-stage work in progress; some features and online catalogues are still under active testing.

[Alpha Preliminare / In Sviluppo] Port sperimentale di ZXTune (r5112) per Daphile / Lyrion Music Server. Riproduce formati chiptune, tracker e musica per videogiochi, archivi multi-traccia, radio casuale e cataloghi online (ModArchive, ModLand, HVSC, ASMA, VGMRips, Khinsider, OCReMix, JoshW, ZX-Art, ZXTunes, AMP, Aminet, Scene.org, AYGOR). Nota: progetto in fase preliminare di sviluppo; alcune funzioni sono ancora in fase di test.
